title: Main board - U13 = AKM AK4637 audio codec, its pins, and the speaker connector J9 (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~112 px/mm in this crop); pin layout from the AK4637 datasheet

callouts.label: AKM AK4637EN: 24-bit mono audio codec with MIC and speaker amplifiers
callouts.part: AK4637EN, 20-pin QFN 3 x 3 mm, 0.4 mm pitch, exposed pad to GND
callouts.note: The marking matches AKM's marking diagram (datasheet 015010680-E-00, p94: '4637' over a 4-digit date code, a pin-1 dot) and the package (p1, p94); next to the speaker connector J9. Turned a quarter counter-clockwise from the datasheet's top view (p6): pin 1 bottom right, pins 1-5 up the right side, 6-10 right to left along the top, 11-15 down the left, 16-20 left to right along the bottom. Control over I2C (7-bit address 0x12, p65), audio over I2S. J-269.

callouts.label: Pin-1 mark (laser dot)
callouts.note: AKM's 'Pin #1 indication' (p94): pin 1 is the right column's bottom lead.

callouts.label: U13 pin 1, AIN/IN+/DMDAT
callouts.note: Analog (mic) input. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 3, SCL
callouts.note: I2C clock from the CC3220 (control port, slave address 0x12): which U1 pin is open (meter). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 4, SDA
callouts.note: I2C data, as pin 3. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 5, SDTI
callouts.note: I2S data into the codec (the sounds from U1). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 6, SDTO
callouts.note: I2S data out of the codec (the ADC). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 10, TVDD
callouts.note: Digital I/O supply, 1.6-3.6 V (3.3 V expected). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 11, DVDD
callouts.note: Digital core supply, 1.6-1.98 V: the board needs a 1.8 V rail for it (U2 nearby is a candidate, guess). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 13, SPN
callouts.note: Speaker amplifier, negative output (BTL): toward J9. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 14, SPP
callouts.note: Speaker amplifier, positive output (BTL): toward J9. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 15, AVDD
callouts.note: Analog and speaker-amp supply, 2.8-5.5 V: 400 mW into 8 Ohm at 3.3 V, 1 W at 5 V. Which rail (3V3 or VIN): meter. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 16, VSS1
callouts.note: Ground 1. Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: U13 pin 20, BEEP/IN-/DMCLK
callouts.note: Beep input (analog). Position from the pin-1 mark and the datasheet's pin layout (p6, p9); its net on this board is not measured yet.

callouts.label: Speaker connector (2-pin)
callouts.note: Twisted yellow/black pair to the round speaker (main-board.md). U13's SPN/SPP (pins 13/14) face it; which J9 pin each reaches: meter.
